本工具需要本机已有的 NBA 2K27 原生 SYNC 名单（单一 roster:
This utility requires a local NBA 2K27 native SYNC roster: a ZIP containing only roster.RDAT and its matching manifest.

Use a compatible update supplied through the game, or a roster pack you are authorized to use and have installed according to its author. It must contain unique player records. Names, mappings, portraits or models alone cannot supply missing records.

Exit the game normally, install the roster update, select the actual SYNC folder and manifest in Settings, then choose Save & import baseline. Run the next sync to update the players that can be matched.

This utility does not supply or download roster packs, create missing players or generate artwork. Missing players are reported and skipped by default; strict mode blocks the update.

无需安装额外名单或补丁包。SYNC RDAT v9 是游戏原生名单的数据格式，工:
No extra roster or patch pack is required. SYNC RDAT v9 names the game's native roster format. The utility uses existing compatible local game data.

When source players are missing, existing real teammates fill gaps. If a team has no matches or cannot form a safe starting five, its previous roster, lineup and player records are preserved. Related transfers are deferred to avoid cross-team duplicates.

Retained players keep their names and data; they do not become the missing players. Strict mode still stops on missing players. Source errors or missing/corrupt native data also stop the operation rather than being reported as successful fallback.

Exit the game, choose its actual SYNC and manifest in Settings, leave the baseline source blank, then choose Save & import baseline. An authorized newer roster is optional for adding real records, not a required dependency.

工具直接使用游戏已有名单，无需额外补丁包。选择游戏程序后自动寻找名单；首次保存会:
The utility uses existing game rosters without an extra pack. Choose the game executable to find its roster automatically; the first save creates a recovery copy. Then use Update only or Update & launch.

Missing players are covered by existing real teammates; a team without matches or a safe starting five keeps its old roster. Related transfers are deferred; missing players are not fabricated.

After installing another roster update you are authorized to use, find the roster again in Settings. Expand Advanced settings, select Re-import the current game roster as a recovery copy, then save. Older recovery copies are retained.
